tasks.description: Create a registration endpoint that accepts an email address and a password. The endpoint should validate the email and password, and reject registration if the email is already in use. The password should be validated to meet a minimum length of 8 characters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email and password, when a user registers, then a new user account is created.
Given an email that is already in use, when a user registers, then an error message is returned.
Given an invalid email or password, when a user registers, then an error message is returned.

tasks.description: Store passwords using bcrypt hashing to ensure secure storage of user credentials. Never store or log plaintext passwords.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user account, when a password is stored, then it is hashed using bcrypt.
Given a user account, when a password is retrieved, then it is not stored in plaintext.

tasks.description: Create a login endpoint that accepts an email and password, verifies the password against the stored bcrypt hash, and rejects invalid credentials with a generic error message.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, when a user logs in, then a successful login response is returned.
Given invalid credentials, when a user logs in, then a generic error message is returned.

tasks.description: On successful login, issue a signed JWT access token that encodes the user identity and an expiry. The frontend attaches this token to subsequent authenticated requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful login, when a JWT token is issued, then it contains the user identity and an expiry.
Given a JWT token, when it is used for an authenticated request, then the request is successfully authenticated.

tasks.description: Create a logout endpoint that ends the user's session so the token can no longer be used for authenticated requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid JWT token, when a user logs out, then the token is invalidated.
Given an invalidated JWT token, when it is used for an authenticated request, then an error message is returned.

tasks.description: Write unit tests to cover the registration, login, and logout endpoints, as well as the password hashing and JWT token issuance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when it is run, then all tests pass.

tasks.description: Write integration tests to cover the entire authentication flow, including registration, login, and logout.
acceptance_criteria: Given an integration test suite, when it is run, then all tests pass.
